purpose: First bounded intake queue for external repository families before cross-source trend promotion.
promotion_rule: An intake item creates observations only after source URL or filing identity, date, unit, denominator, geography, and evidence boundary are captured. A repository-level synthesis is never promoted as an observed outcome by itself.

items.boundary: Ranking and reported growth are source-scoped signals. They do not establish demand, causality, peer identity, or customer outcomes.
This is a synthesis over company records. It is a candidate signal until the underlying company and independent source links are captured and checked.
Opportunity screens describe a research queue, not verified market size, willingness to pay, or realized outcomes.
The theme map is an editorial synthesis. It identifies repeated pressure patterns but does not prove every company, payment, causal mechanism, or investment result.
Corpus size establishes inventory scope, not independent confirmation, currentness, causality, or customer outcomes.
IBIS labels these findings discovery hypotheses; they are not causal validation or evidence of realized market outcomes.
Force chains are working hypotheses until claim-level evidence, counterevidence, and falsifiers are attached.
